messages:
maria-cs: Hey team — Frostline Health (trial account) asking to onboard a clinical summarizer model. They prefer a ~13B fine-tuned variant, require PHI masking, and insist that all evaluation runs happen locally (no external data transfers). Pilot target: Wed next week. Any regulatory or infra blockers? cc @tess-onboard

 t ess-onboard: On it. Can you paste their data schema + expected throughput? We'll need 50–200 sample notes (anonymized) and a direct eng contact. Also flag if they want Dedicated vs Private.

 raj-privacy: PHI constraints mean Private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) is required. Is the DPA fully signed? If not, we must pause external processing. Also confirm retention policy: by default no request logs stored and customer-managed KMS for keys. cc legal/team

 maria-cs: DPA is in final review with their legal — they said "no data leaves our VPC for evals". They can run our eval harness in their enclave if we provide it.

 ticket-bot: Support ticket CS-4821 created for Frostline model intake.

 tess-onboard: Tentative onboarding plan:
 - Intake + sample data collection
 - Eval harness delivered for local run in their enclave
 - Quant/latency profile recommendations
 - Canary deploy (10% traffic) -> full rollout
 I scheduled an enablement call Thu 10:00 PT with Frostline engs. Invite sent.

 kevin-safety: Safety checklist (quick): hallucination thresholds, clinical-entity extraction F1, red-flag triggers (med change / allergy errs), deterministic fallback policy (structured extract + pass-through). Need labeled set for hallucination measurement (500 examples ideal).

 kevin-safety: Quick eval harness stub for enclave run (will expand):
 ```python
 # pseudo-eval: compute entity F1 and hallucination rate
 def eval_batch(preds, gold):
     f1 = compute_clinical_f1(preds, gold)
     hallucination = sum(1 for p,g in zip(preds,gold) if has_invented_entities(p,g))/len(preds)
     return {"clinical_f1": f1, "hallucination_rate": hallucination}
 ```

 raj-privacy: Also require: audit logs exported to customer's S3, KMS key config, and confirmation that Redwood ops won't pull model weights for troubleshooting (customer asked for weight-access restriction). We'll sync with legal for DPA clause.

 maria-cs: FYI — renewal risk note: Frostline said they'll convert to a Dedicated/Private contract if pilot meets <10% hallucination and p50 latency <400ms. They said if pilot is delayed >2 weeks they may deprioritize. Marking this as medium-high renewal risk if timelines slip.

 tess-onboard: I'll add acceptance criteria to the intake doc and tag the renewal manager. Action items: @maria-cs get sample notes + POC contact; @kevin-safety draft the eval kit; @raj-privacy confirm DPA status with legal.

 maria-cs: On it — sending anonymized 200 sample notes via secure link today. Thanks :pray:

 kevin-safety: Received sample link. I'll push a preliminary eval script to the shared enclave repo by EOD tomorrow.

 ticket-bot: Reminder: CS-4821 updated — intake form submitted.
